failure_modes.when: the id is not one of your surfaces

failure_modes.recovery: Re-read, then retry with the fresh updated_at.
failure_modes.when: expected_updated_at was passed and another tab moved the surface first

preconditions: Position saves are REAL entity updates — pass x/y/w/h/z_index; kind/widget_key/content_ref are immutable.

description: Moves, resizes, or restacks a surface already on the desk canvas — x/y/w/h/z_index are real column writes, not a layout cache. The surface's identity is frozen here: kind, widget_key, and content_ref never change through this door, only via delete then re-create. NEXT: desk_surface_list to find the id to move.

expected_updated_at.description: Optional compare-and-set guard: the updated_at from a prior desk_surface_list/read. Mismatch returns CONFLICT — another tab already moved this surface.

name: desk_surface_update
